expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Defines Settings, Team, IncomingEmail, RoutingDecision types; async classify_email() function; process_webhook() entry point; create_ticket(); module-level client setup; complete flow

expectations.text: Uses structured output against a schema rather than parsing the model's prose
expectations.evidence: tools=[{"input_schema": RoutingDecision.model_json_schema()}] with tool_choice forcing tool; parses block.input via RoutingDecision.model_validate()

expectations.text: Constrains the classification to a closed set the code enforces, not just the prompt
expectations.evidence: Team = Literal["billing", "technical", "account"]; RoutingDecision.team typed as Team; Pydantic validation enforces constraint

expectations.text: Handles the case where the model returns something outside the allowed set
expectations.evidence: RoutingDecision.model_validate(block.input) raises ValidationError if invalid team returned; exception propagates with explicit failure; design rationale acknowledges delegation to queue

expectations.text: Has a deterministic fallback or explicit failure path rather than a silent default
expectations.evidence: match/assert_never ensures exhaustive branching; no silent defaults; ValidationError propagates explicitly

expectations.text: Treats the customer email as untrusted text that could carry instructions
Bounds cost or retries in code rather than requesting it in the prompt
expectations.evidence: max_tokens=1024 and temperature=0.0 set in API call

expectations.text: Closes by naming which failures the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Section 'Mistake-proofing Design Rationale' enumerates 5 misuses with devices and rungs; section 'Consciously left possible' acknowledges Claude hallucinating invalid JSON
